missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Задача' is the nominative subject and predicate noun. 'Сложная' agrees in the feminine, and 'очень' intensifies the difficulty.
Strategic focus: Accusative object with dative recipient. 'Задачу' is the accusative object of 'дал', while 'нам' is the dative recipient. 'Трудную' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'над'. 'Задачей' is the instrumental required by 'над' in the sense of working on a problem. 'Долго' adds duration.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Задачи' is genitive, expressing whose solution is lacking. 'Нет решения' uses a second genitive to state the absence.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'приступить к'. 'Задаче' is the dative governed by 'к', expressing the start of work on something. 'Новой' agrees in the feminine dative.

missions.phrase: Я думаю об этой задаче весь день.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об этой задаче' uses the prepositional form 'задаче' after 'об' to mark the topic of thought. 'Весь день' adds duration.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'без'. 'Задачи' is genitive following 'без' to express absence. 'Чёткой' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Задачу' is the accusative direct object of 'решил'. 'Эту' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'уже' marks completion.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Задачи' is the nominative plural subject of 'стоят'. 'Важные' agrees in the plural, and 'перед нами' is instrumental.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural after 'справиться с'. 'Задачами' is the instrumental plural governed by 'со'. 'Всеми' agrees in the plural, marking success.
